title: Replication #2: Multi-Field Structured Support & PII Dispatcher
user_cohort: COHORT-CANARY-B2 (N=20 independent pilot operators, 0 overlap with M001)
goal: Verify whether deterministic, edge-level input sanitization and friction reduction generalize to a complex, multi-field structured support dispatch workflow without introducing UX hesitation or security regressions.
jtbd: When a pilot operator needs to submit a structured operational request, quota increase, or support ticket containing environment metadata, they need an accessible multi-field form that validates and sanitizes PII/credentials in real-time, so tickets are processed immediately without exposing confidential data.
falsification_conditions: Security regression (any unmasked credit card PAN, SSN, PII, or auth token leaks)
Significant performance degradation (> 35 KB bundle or > 10ms mount latency)
Severe UX breakdown (task completion drops below 85% or time-on-task > 60s)
Failure against adversarial novelty class (double-URL encoding, prototype pollution, homoglyph attack)
